payload.explanation: The business UPDATE (session_8e83b6769bfe, pid 674) is active and waiting on Lock: transactionid, with blocking_pids=[675]. PID 675 (session_ff0d37379681) is 'idle in transaction' after having run the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1, so it holds the row/transaction lock on product_id=1 and is waiting on ClientRead — an abandoned open transaction. Other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_627e1300799f, session_3a5b6f3e1aaa) ran only SELECT 1 and block nothing. Query stats show the blocker's UPDATE completed (1 call, 1 row) but never committed; indexes show only the PK (no redundant index), and table stats show no vacuum/bloat. Root blocker is session_ff0d37379681; resolution is rolling back that eligible owned session, which releases the lock and lets the business request proceed. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
